title: agent-comm-hub agent registry
description: Declarative registry of supported agents for `agent-comm-hub setup` / `discover`. One record per agent; adding a new agent requires a record here (plus a test), no code changes.

id.description: Stable identifier; also the config key default when not overridden.

probe.description: Command names checked against PATH (any hit = agent installed).

file.description: Config path template, `~`-relative; one `*` path segment expands over matching subdirectories (e.g. DSH profiles). Must not contain `..`.

section.description: JSON section path (dotted, e.g. `mcp.servers`) for strategy json; null otherwise.

strategy.description: Merge strategy: json = JSON section merge; toml = section append; dsh = YAML insert with marker.

entry.description: Server entry template; `{url}` / `{serverName}` placeholders are substituted. Null for toml/dsh.

skill.description: Private skill directory (`~`-relative) for this agent; null = no skill.
